newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy PSBR data in line with deficit goal - Ciampi.
newsitem.headline: Italy PSBR data in line with deficit goal - Ciampi.

text.p: Public sector borrowing data for July was in line with the government's goal to reduce the public deficit to 3.0 percent of gross domestic produce this year, Treasury Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi said in a statement.
Earlier, the Treasury said Italy's PSBR was 4.3 trillion lire in July 1997, some 5.55 trillion lire less than the same month last year.

"This (data) confirms the large reduction in the deficit that was seen in the first half of the year and is in line with the end-of year objective for a public administration deficit equivalent to 3.0 percent of GDP," Ciampi's statement said.

Italy has pledged to hit the three percent target this year to meet a key requirement laid down in the Maastricht Treaty for countries wishing to sign up to the single European currency from its launch in 1999.
Italy's deficit/GDP ratio was 6.7 percent in 1996.
